purpose: Correct the previous three material studies into a strict flat side-view cross-section without visible ground top planes.
method: Built-in image_gen.imagegen; three reference-guided image revisions using a deterministic planar shape guide.
methodReason: Hand-drawn large concept illustrations. Deterministic SVG is only the shape guide, not a substitute for painted output.
nativeDimensions: Record actual generated PNG dimensions; preserve original bytes.
seams: No tile or common-edge claim; the shared guide constrains composition only.
shapePrecision: Planar silhouette is the target. Generated curves are not certified collision geometry or exact guide pixels.
projectionContract: Camera normal to the gameplay XY plane; no view from above.
Ground has one visible boundary, without an upper surface or receding path.
Rock interior lies below/above the silhouette as a flat illustrated cut-section.
Character feet and plants attach to the same contour, not rows at different depths.
Backgrounds are quiet flat silhouette layers.
Rock markings and ore are flat material drawings, not extruded volumes.
scope: Static art-direction correction only. No source sprite, Spine, Game, YYGC, collision, WFC or Unity changes.
